name: ACA NeoGeo Selection Vol. 4
summary:
A collection of Arcade Archives NEOGEO releases for the Nintendo Switch.

This package contains:
Art of Fighting 3
The King of Fighters 2000
The Last Blade
Metal Slug
Neo Geo Cup ’98: The Road to the Victory
Ninja Commando
Pulstar
Puzzled
Ragnagard
The Super Spy
